name: visual-qa
title_zh: 截图前后对照，专治 WebGL 画布「看着不对」
tagline_zh: 改了几行着色器，画面糊了还是布局歪了？不用再凭肉眼猜。它替你截前后两张图，并排比像素差异。
tagline_en: Changed a shader and the canvas looks off? Stop guessing. It captures before/after screenshots, diffs pixels, and.
desc_en: Screenshot discipline for visual checks of WebGL/canvas scenes and layouts. Use when asked whether something \"looks right\", for before/after comparisons, or for viewport coverage.
why_zh: 把「看起来对不对」从主观印象变成可复现的截图证据。自动对齐时间戳与视口尺寸，差异区域直接高亮。
why_en: Turns "does it look right" into reproducible screenshot evidence—timestamps and viewport aligned, diffs highlighted, no.
limit_zh: 只认浏览器里的 WebGL/canvas 场景与页面布局，不接原生窗口或视频流。截图对比依赖同一视口尺寸。
limit_en: Only for WebGL/canvas scenes and page layouts in-browser; no native windows or video streams. Diff assumes fixed viewport size—resize invalidates.
title_en: Screenshot discipline for WebGL/canvas visual checks
